notes.title: New Village
notes.notes: A new big location has been added. Go to an old Siberian village, walk through a snow-covered forest, listen to the singing of birds and enjoy life! A new level will allow you to immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the Siberian wilderness. This place has long been abandoned by people, but the stunning views of the local nature and architecture will not let you get bored. The harsh but beautiful north is waiting!
